items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: They were able to teach me English and see that I do the right things... They'd show me what to play here, how to play here

ctx.x: Yeah, private parties, private homes and things like that, you know what I mean. The wealthy people, you can tell.
Right. And then you were playing with Nevil Cecil, when Tony Lattner and Sidney Bechet --
